summary: Key catalysts: (1) May 21 Analyst Day in NYC with detail on Power Systems next capacity tranche; $3.5B in 2025 data center revenue positioned to grow 10-20% in 2026 from supply-constrained backlog. (2) Doubled 95-liter high-speed diesel engine capacity ahead of schedule; record Q4 order intake extends backlog into 2028. (3) EPA 2027 low-NOx engine standard confirmed at 35mg, driving estimated $10,000-$15,000 per-truck price increase. Recent: Q1 2026 revenue $8.4B (+3% YoY) beat on adjusted EPS, driven by record Power Systems quarter on data-center backup-power demand. Mgmt raised full-year 2026 guidance and returned $519M to shareholders. Insider selling noted in narrative-shift article (2026-05-02).
